post.title: Types of Locks Explained: Optimistic vs. Pessimistic Locking
post.subtitle: How do you prevent two users from editing the same record at the same time? We compare Optimistic Locking (Versioning) and Pessimistic Locking (Databa
post.brief: Pessimistic locking locks the record *before* editing — safe but slower under low contention. Optimistic locking checks for changes *before saving* using a version number — fast but can fail and require retry under high contention. Choosing correctly depends on your write-conflict probability.
